```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(lme4)
library(broom.mixed)
library(lmerTest)
library(car)
library(mitml)
library(miceadds)
library(emmeans)
library(mitools)
library(ggplot2)

rm(list = ls())
```

```{r load data}

bas_rresp <- readRDS("Data/bas.Rds")
class(bas_rresp) <- "mitml.list"

```


### BAS Reward Responsiveness - resilience/adversity interactions ###

### PROSOCIAL BEHAVIOR ###

# null model

```{r}

model_null <- with(bas_rresp, lmer
  (rew_resp_modified ~ race_ethnicity + sex + cg_psych + ses_dis_nsafety + primary_cg_lack_supp
                + second_cg_lack_supp + yp_family_conflict + cg_sub_use_bio_sep + family_anger_arg + family_aggression
                + trauma_exposure + lack_supervision + ps_behav + age + age_sq +
                (1 + age | subjectkey) + (1 | family_id), control = lmerControl(
   optimizer = "bobyqa",
   optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5)
   )))

```

# Lack of supervision 

```{r}

model_alt <- with(bas_rresp, lmer(
  rew_resp_modified ~ race_ethnicity + sex + cg_psych + ses_dis_nsafety +
    primary_cg_lack_supp + second_cg_lack_supp + yp_family_conflict + cg_sub_use_bio_sep + family_anger_arg + family_aggression
                + trauma_exposure + lack_supervision + ps_behav + age + age_sq + ps_behav*lack_supervision +
                (1 + age | subjectkey) + (1 | family_id),
  control = lmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5)
  )
))

ls_ps_behav_int <- testModels(model_alt, model_null, method = "D1")

ls_ps_behav_int

testEstimates(model_alt, extra.pars = TRUE)
est <- testEstimates(model_alt, extra.pars = TRUE)
confint(est)                    
```

### MID Reward Anticipation ###

```{r}

```


# Pos school env

# null model

```{r}

  (accumbens_antic ~ race_ethnicity + sex + cg_psych + ses_dis_nsafety + primary_cg_lack_supp
                + second_cg_lack_supp + yp_family_conflict + cg_sub_use_bio_sep + family_anger_arg + family_aggression
                + trauma_exposure + lack_supervision + pos_school_env + age + age_sq +
                (1 | subjectkey) + (1 | family_id) + (1 | site_id), control = lmerControl(
   optimizer = "bobyqa",
   optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5)
   )))



```


```{r}

model_alt <- with(fmri, lmer
  (accumbens_antic ~ race_ethnicity + sex + cg_psych + ses_dis_nsafety + primary_cg_lack_supp
                + second_cg_lack_supp + yp_family_conflict + cg_sub_use_bio_sep + family_anger_arg + family_aggression
```
